manual.rule: Disk, Quick Load and Sampling displays have no sound output, Copy commands also suppress sound.

limits: Native original-firmware floppy performance Save under incoming MIDI; partial disk trace is positive overlap evidence only. Serial delivery is not event preservation. Disk-mode mute/recovery is supported; no simultaneous disk/MIDI/voice arbitration or physical timing claim.
classification: Native original-firmware functional restriction/recovery, plus local owner-manual evidence
prerequisites: Windows x64 native MAME build, Python/numpy/Pillow, locally supplied original IC15/OS2.24 and fingerprinted ROBOFULL floppy

current_load_requalification.firmware_restriction: Disk/Load clears playable voices before FDC commands and suppresses new note allocations. Return to Perform before auditioning; no event-preservation or musical-continuity guarantee during Load.
current_load_requalification.limits: Named workload robustness/restriction qualification; no observed three-source simultaneous IRQ arbitration. Sample Load-under-MIDI qualified separately; bitmap clears in Disk are not labelled natural completions.

gate_resolution: The former requirement to identify an operation permitting simultaneous disk/MIDI/voices was based on an unsupported firmware assumption. Owner manual Advanced1-3 explicitly suppresses sound in Disk/Quick Load/Sampling and while commands such as Copy execute. Replaced with the qualified mute/recovery contract; three-source arbitration remains unclaimed.
